fact: The EU Delegation, Government of Lesotho and UNICEF launched the Digital Birth Registration system within the Ntlafatsa Bana programme.
source_slug: 2025-04-02 Lesotho launches Digital Birth Registration under Ntlafatsa Bana programme

fact: Lesotho's NICR presentation to UNECA's 2026 expert group meeting lists 'Scale Up Digital Birth Registration Nationwide' for 2026-2027 and names digital birth registration as the solution for remote communities.

UNICEF's Lesotho office reports the Ntlafatsa Bana project launched a tablet-based digital birth registration system in Ha-Tankele, run by Village Health Workers and Civil Registration Officers and integrated with the NISSA social assistance database.
system: Ntlafatsa Bana digital birth registration system

fact: UNICEF Lesotho says 30 birth registration stations supported by an SMS-based platform have been established in government and CHAL health facilities across Maseru, Berea and Leribe.
